project: Interplanetary Survival Guide — 2D Mars Map MVP

layers.name: MOLA Shaded Relief / Colorized Elevation
layers.provider: Arizona State University (ASU) Mars Global Data Sets
layers.resolution: 128 pixels per degree; approximately 463.1 m per pixel
layers.caveat: Colorized visual product; RGB values are not numeric elevation measurements.

layers.name: MOLA MEGDR Topography
layers.provider: NASA Planetary Data System Geosciences Node
layers.format: PDS IMG binary plus matching LBL label
layers.caveat: Decode using the product label/SIS before numeric use; verify scaling, units, byte order and map geometry.

not_included: No numeric slope raster has been generated.
No water-ice evidence layer has been generated.
No fabricated measurement values are included.
